search_QdrantClient: search a Qdrant collection using a query vector and return the nearest neighbor results
insert_QdrantClient: insert vector items into a Qdrant collection, creating the collection if it does not exist
upsert_QdrantClient: upsert vector items into a Qdrant collection, updating existing or inserting new entries
query_QdrantClient: query a Qdrant collection by metadata filter conditions and return matching points
delete_QdrantClient: delete items from a Qdrant collection by ids or metadata filter conditions
